description: This file is a shell script that initializes and configures a unet (wireguard-based VPN) protocol, defining functions for setting up and tearing down network configurations, and referencing external scripts and commands.

methods.name: proto_unet_init_config
methods.description: Initializes the unet protocol configuration with various parameters such as device, type, keys, domain, and network options.

methods.name: proto_unet_setup
methods.description: Sets up the unet tunnel configuration, creating the wireguard device, and registering it with the system.

methods.name: proto_unet_teardown
methods.description: Removes the wireguard device and deregisters the unet configuration.

methods.name: add_protocol
methods.description: Registers the unet protocol into the system.
